text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: —Oh? Groove, are you heading out today?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Yeah, I'm heading out to Kyoto.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
("The Empress" Air Groove. Fine Motion's 
wonderful roommate.)

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Kyoto!? Must be nice, are you going to get 
some udon or something?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...I'm not quite the gourmet that you are.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"Watching a GⅠ race. —It's the Queen 
Elizabeth II Cup."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: The Queen Elizabeth II Cup...!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Unfortunately, I've never seen it in 
person. What kind of race is it to you?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Even within the Twinkle Series, this is 
one of the most crucial races.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
That race is filled with nobility, 
pride... and respect.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
The pride of standing at the starting 
line. Respect for the rivals who fought 
their way up just like her, and for the 
spectators watching over them...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I ran in it before as well. It was a 
bitter result... but a dazzling memory 
nonetheless.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"Competing for victory in this race... I 
can still recall it so vividly."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
There's a live broadcast, so you should 
watch it too. It is the "Queen" Elizabeth 
II Cup, after all—surely you're 
interested?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Then, I'm heading out.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: ...! Wait, Groove-san!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I'd love some savory souvenirs♪ I'll be 
waiting!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
“—And so, do you want to watch the Queen 
Elizabeth II Cup together?”

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: It's decided! Fufu, I can't wait~♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so began this year's Queen Elizabeth 
II Cup... and it turned into a fierce 
battle!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"—A thrilling battle to the wire in the 
Queen Elizabeth II Cup! Three runners 
cross the finish line neck and neck!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As if on cue, the Umamusume crossed the 
finish line together in a flash, sending 
cheers echoing across the venue.

text_block_list.name: Cheering on TV
text_block_list.text: "Waaaaaaaaaah...!!"

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Ah...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: That was an incredible race...!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Everyone was shining so brightly. Their 
desire to win came through so strongly it 
practically gave me chills...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I'm only watching, yet my chest aches so 
much.
choice_data_list:
I could really feel your determination to 
win.

I could really feel your determination to 
win.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Making it into a GⅠ race is impossible 
with ordinary effort. Those who worked 
relentlessly gather together, striving for 
that single 1st place spot."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
...Groove-san said it too. That it's a 
race she can still remember vividly even 
now.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"The Queen Elizabeth II Cup... There's 
'something' there, isn't there?"

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Wanting to win, huh...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Fine Motion murmured softly. Her eyes gave 
no hint of the deep emotions stirring 
within—
